_doc: Single source of truth for part dimensions (mm), pins, I2C addresses, currents (mA) per firmware mode, prices. Sources in docs/01-survey.md. 'unverified' fields are marked.

cell.name: LiPo cell (AU: Core CE04375 400 mAh 38x25x6; US: Adafruit 1578 500 mAh 36x29x4.75)
cell.capacity_note: runtime computed on the 400 mAh AU cell (conservative); the 500 mAh US cell gives 1.25x

mcu.name: Adafruit ESP32-S3 Feather 4MB/2MB PSRAM (ADA5477)
mcu.current_src: SLEEP: Adafruit '~100uA deep sleep'. PRESENT/NIGHT: 5% duty at 80 MHz dual-core 33.1 mA (ESP32-S3 DS Table 5-9) + 95% light-sleep 0.24 mA (Table 5-10) = 1.88 mA. ATTENTION/WAKE: 80 MHz dual-core 33.1 mA continuous.

display.name: Adafruit 1.28in round 240x240 GC9A01A (ADA6178)
display.holes_note: hole positions on the PCB unverified
display.current_src: 31.2 mA whole module at 3.3 V with backlight full (Waveshare GC9A01 twin, wiki); Adafruit module unverified. PRESENT = 40% backlight PWM, NIGHT = 10%, ATTENTION/WAKE = 100%. SLEEP = backlight off + display sleep, residual unverified (taken as 0).

ring.name: NeoPixel Ring 24 (ADA1586)
ring.current_src: Rail switched off in SLEEP/PRESENT/NIGHT (0 mA). On: 24 x (1 mA dark [PJRC] + 20% of 60 mA full white [Adafruit]) = 312 mA. Brightness cap LED_MAX_BRIGHTNESS in config.h.

presence.name: Adafruit STHS34PF80 IR presence (ADA6426)
presence.current_src: 10 uA at 1 Hz ODR (SparkFun hookup guide / ST); always on, INT wakes the MCU.

lux.name: Adafruit VEML7700 (ADA4162)
lux.dims_note: PCB size unverified; STEMMA QT class board assumed
lux.current_src: Vishay DS p.2: 45 uA operating (PSM off), 8 uA PSM mode 600 ms refresh used in SLEEP.

encoder.name: Bourns PEC11R-4220F-S0024 (20 mm D shaft, switch, 24 det)
encoder.body_note: 12.5 x 13.4 face, 7.0 mm behind mounting surface + 3.7 mm pins (Bourns DS)

pins.to: I2C SDA: STHS34PF80 (0x5A), SHT41 (0x44), VEML7700 (0x10), fuel gauge (0x36/0x0B)
STEMMA QT 3.3 V switched rail -> NeoPixel ring VCC (ring is the only load on the switched rail; sensors on always-on 3V)
Encoder switch (RTC GPIO, ext1 wake source)
STHS34PF80 INT (RTC GPIO, ext1 wake source)

i2c_notes: DRV2605L haptic (no-limit tier) is fixed at 0x5A and collides with STHS34PF80 -> not on the bus.
Adafruit I2C QT Rotary Encoder (ADA4991) default 0x36 collides with the MAX17048 fuel gauge -> direct GPIO encoder used instead.

wifi.name: Wi-Fi listen for the Claude usage push (optional, CLAUDE_WIFI_ENABLED)
wifi.current_src: unverified estimate: station connected in modem-sleep (DTIM listen). ESP32-S3 DS gives only peaks (Wi-Fi RX 88 mA, TX 283-340 mA); the average depends on the AP's DTIM. Off in SLEEP and when CLAUDE_WIFI_ENABLED = 0 (default).
